immutable_specialists.S0_C00: confirmed C00 G04/H05 affinity and partition from Night-6C/Night-7A, exposed as Night-7B H00

label_free_feature_contract.m_initial: the R02 MNN component on the first formal forward before the first optimizer step, recomputed from the locked input, fixed MNN indices and deterministic initialization; it must match the first saved loss-curve value within 1e-7
label_free_feature_contract.c_i: 1-cosine(u00_i,u04_i) from the fresh-reloaded R02 model's two graph summaries before equal fusion
label_free_feature_contract.rank_c_i: deterministic tied-average percentile rank of c_i in [0,1] within the unit; n=1 maps to 0
label_free_feature_contract.q_i: clip((d_second_i-d_positive_i)/(d_second_i+1e-12),0,1), where d_positive is the fixed reciprocal-MNN positive distance and d_second is the nearest deterministic alternative not equal to that positive
label_free_feature_contract.s_i: Jaccard overlap in [0,1] between the deterministic top-10 neighbor sets of u00_i and u04_i; no original h5ad read is allowed

affinity_mix_contract.row_normalization: row-normalize each nonnegative specialist affinity with zero-degree fail-closed
affinity_mix_contract.two_way: B=diag(1-alpha)@R(S0)+diag(alpha)@R(S2); S=0.5*(B+B.T); set diagonal to zero; eliminate zeros; canonical CSR
affinity_mix_contract.three_way: B=diag(w0)@R(S0)+diag(w8)@R(S8)+diag(w2)@R(S2); S=0.5*(B+B.T); set diagonal to zero; eliminate zeros; canonical CSR
affinity_mix_contract.partition: the exact Night-7B spectral-discretize implementation with locked K and seed semantics

routing_candidates.weights: alpha_i=1 if m_initial>=0.30 else 0 for every spot

weighted_mnn_architecture.weight_normalization: nonzero per-spot weights are divided by their arithmetic mean before the weighted MNN mean, except filtered zeros remain zero

weighted_mnn_candidates.weight: 1 for the highest 75 percent q_i using deterministic stable order, otherwise 0

spatial_protection_contract_vs_C00.semantics: Reuse the exact Night-7B metric implementation and compare same-seed candidate means with C00; no metric redefinition is allowed.
